messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 502/504 rate observed on api-gateway-eu-central. 2.8% error rate over 5m, growing. Paging on-call.

oncall-eng: Ack, I'm on it. hopping in zoom now.

maya: seeing a giant uptick in backend upstream 502s from a subset of clients. Lots of identical User-Agent strings, bursts of retries.

eli: do we have recent deploys? I only see routine LB config refresh ~20m ago.

maya: no deploys to gateway in last 2h. telemetry shows continuous 502s from upstream pool behind svc-inference-eu.

sam: dumping a few logs:
```
[2026-02-12T14:05:23Z] svc-inference-eu: upstream error 502, connect timeout to worker-12
[2026-02-12T14:05:24Z] gateway: client retry x3 from 10.240.12.0/24
```

maya: looks like clients are retrying aggressively and exhausting backend concurrency -> connection churn -> 502s. retry-loop hypothesis.

oncall-eng: immediate mitigations?

eli: 1) rate-limit retries at edge for that UA/netblock 2) enable short circuiting/circuit-breaker for svc-inference-eu 3) traffic-shift small portion to eu-east for critical customers.

maya: adding quick rule to block repeated retry header x-retry-count >2 for 60s. applying now.

ops-bot: Rule applied: block header-pattern "X-Retry-Count>2" -> 60s for route /v1/generate on api-gateway-eu-central.

sam: turning on circuit-breaker (429 fast-fail) for svc-inference-eu at 30% error threshold. doing rollout to 10% then ramp.

support-lead: heads-up to support: customers with high QPS may see elevated 429/502 during mitigation; prepping short message for affected accounts.

maya: meanwhile, I'm seeing KV cache thrash on backend that correlates with high cold-starts. working with infra to increase hot-pool size for inference workers by +2.

eli: infra confirmed scaling action: adding 4 warm workers to pool. ETA ~3m.

support-lead: drafting customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xxs in EU region, mitigating, next update in 30m." Share list of top impacted customers?

sam: compiled top 10 by error volume, DMing support.

oncall-eng: after applying edge retry rule + circuit-breaker, error rate dropped to 0.9% in 60s. Good signal.

maya: confirming backend p95 latency improved, connection retries reduced by ~70%.

ops-bot: autoscale action completed: +4 workers added to svc-inference-eu.

eli: recommend keeping retry-limit rule in place for 1h while we monitor, then convert to targeted rate-limit on the client IP ranges.

support-lead: sent initial customer note to impacted list. filed a ticket with priority P2 for follow-up and RCA.

oncall-eng: I'll stay on watch for 1h, then hand off to day shift. Please capture timeline and actions for postmortem.

maya: capturing debug snippets and graphs to a runbook doc. will add sample log lines and correlation charts.

sam: any followups for code/infra? We should add a cheap circuit-breaker at the gateway level to avoid future retry-loop amplification.

eli: agree, add to SPRINT backlog: gateway-level exponential backoff enforcement + metrics alert for retry-fanout.

support-lead: final update for now: errors back near baseline, mitigation stable. monitoring. will reopen thread if regressions. :white_check_mark:
